style: Say softly and calmly, like a mindfulness teacher
lines: Look at this painting. What mood is it? Tap a mood.
Now tap the things in the painting that told you.
Pick a mood at the top. Then change the time, the light, the colors or the weather.
Each change is a clue. The compass shows which way it points.
Tap a clue in My clues to tag the mood you meant.
Let a partner look at your picture. Ask them to tap a mood.
Finish both sentences to explain your picture and connect it to your life.
Type your reason, then tap Keep my reason.
Tap the mood you meant for this clue.
Tap a clue in My clues to explain it, or change a control to revise your picture.
Change another control, or add a detail, to build your mood.
Saving is unavailable. You can still make a picture while this page stays open.
